programme.title: New: Secrets In The Ice
programme.desc: In Siberia, a 44,000-year-old wolf, perfectly preserved in permafrost, may hold secrets about Ice Age bacteria and ancient microbial life. (S4, ep 2)

programme.title: Forbidden History
programme.desc: Hitler's Holidays of Hate: Experts investigate the methods that Adolf Hitler and the Nazis used to indoctrinate a peaceful population, turning it into a finely-tuned war machine. (S7, ep 1)

programme.title: World's Greatest Treasure Mysteries
programme.desc: Captain Bellamy's Bounty: Rick, Tony and Matty join Barry join the search for artefacts and treasure connected to the Whydah shipwreck off the coast of Cape Cod. (S3, ep 6)

programme.title: Alien Files: Unsealed
programme.desc: Experts open previously off-limits files in a bid to answer some of the most mysterious questions surrounding UFOs and extra-terrestrial life. (S1, ep 7)

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Aliens Among Us: Are we being watched by otherworldly beings? Experts make surprising discoveries as they explore the ancient past for evidence of alien overseers. (S7, ep 4)

programme.title: Airport Security USA
programme.desc: Passengers are searched for illegal objects when entering and leaving the United States by the Department of Homeland Security's Customs and Border Protection officers. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Seized At Sea
programme.desc: Agents conducting a stop-search of vehicles coming off a car ferry get a hit, they come across a shipment of t-shirts that may all be counterfeit. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Cash Kings: An out-of-character Les makes an impulse decision that threatens to backfire, and later gives a big loan to a customer with a dubious sob story. Has he been fleeced? (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: Welwyn Garden City 2: David Dickinson and his antique dealers travel to Welwyn Garden City, where they find an unusual letter opener and some flying helmets. (S10, ep 6)

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: Barnsley 1: Join David Dickinson as more collectors try to sell their items to dealers. Will they strike a deal or will they take a chance at auction instead? (S10, ep 41)

programme.title: New: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: The Rick-sy Rebellion: A seller whips into the shop with an 'energy dome' hat made for the band DEVO, while Corey takes a shot at a decanter set that belonged to Buffalo Bill. (S24, ep 2)

programme.title: Storage Hunters
programme.desc: Bowling for Billions: Cash flies over a locker that reveals a high-ticket mystery item, before everyone digs deep to win an ATM - but will this be a major regret? (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: Storage Hunters
programme.desc: Sin City Sucker Punch: An old rivalry resurfaces in Vegas, before a locker reveals a covered item that's thought to be a vintage car - but will the buyer drive away happy? (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: Storage Wars Texas

programme.title: Storage Wars Texas
programme.desc: Bronze Beauty: The auction action moves to the tiny town of Pantego, Texas, where one pair of buyers strikes gold with a curious wooden box. (S4, ep 4)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn
programme.desc: Acid Test: While Seth mulls over an expensive purchase that could save the store thousands, a customer attempts to sell a coat allegedly made of rare monkey fur. (S3, ep 3)

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Cinematic Journey
programme.desc: Kyle Card hikes along a 1000km trail following the Pacific Coast in northern Japan - he discovers local lifestyles, stunning nature, traces of the area's 2011 disaster and resilient people.

programme.title: Grand Sumo Highlights
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan presents a sumo highlights programme for fans around the globe featuring all top-division bouts from Day 2 of the latest Grand Sumo tournament in Tokyo.

programme.title: Sumopedia
programme.desc: Sumopedia enriches your sumo experience with information on the techniques, traditions and famous wrestlers of the past - the rules may be simple, but there is a lot more to sumo than meets the eye...

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Matsuri: The Heartbeat of Japan
programme.desc: Gojinjo Taiko is a wild and powerful performance by masked drummers - it originated 400 years ago when villagers disguised themselves as oni (demons) to scare away a warlord's army.

programme.title: Nun's Cookbook
programme.desc: Learn how to make furofuki daikon with two sauces. Both sauces use a fresh white miso base, but one is made with chopped butterbur and the other with yuzu citrus. Serve with boiled daikon.

programme.title: Journeys in Japan
programme.desc: Rachael Aoki follows 19th-century explorer Isabella Bird from Nara to Ise Jingu Shrine via Hasedera Temple.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Director: Cy Endfield. Stars Phyllis Calvert, Eric Portman & Stanley Baker. A girl is left with her relatives while her mother is in hospital. Her father, a crook, pays her a visit.

programme.title: Home and Away
programme.desc: 1956. Drama directed by Vernon Sewell and starring Jack Warner, Thora Hird, Harry Fowler and Kathleen Harrison. Based on 'The Huggetts' family rivalry when two sons win the football pools.

programme.title: Circumstantial Evidence (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Director: Daniel Birt. Stars: Rona Anderson, Patrick Holt & John Arnatt. Cleverly crafted crime drama - A woman seeks evidence that will give her grounds for divorce.

programme.title: Parade
programme.desc: 1974. Comedy. Directed by Jacques Tati. Stars Karl Kossmayer, Michele Brabo & Bertil Berglund. A tremendous spectacle combining music, circus acts and pantomime, hosted by comedian Jacques Tati.

programme.title: Suspected Person
programme.desc: 1942. Drama. Director: Lawrence Huntington. Stars Clifford Evans, Patricia Roc, David Farrar, Robert Beatty, William Hartnell. Two bank robbers try to find their partner, who fled to London.

programme.title: White Corridors
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Directed by Pat Jackson. Stars Googie Withers, James Donald & Petula Clark. An insightful story about the day to day activities within Yeoman's Hospital during the early 1950s.

programme.title: Forbidden
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directed by George King. Stars Douglass Montgomery, Hazel Court & Patricia Burke. An ex-serviceman plans to escape his faithless wife.

programme.title: The Wicked Lady
programme.desc: 1945. Drama. Directed by Leslie Arliss. Stars Margaret Lockwood, Griffith Jones & James Mason. 17th Century beauty Barbara Worth leads a double life to relieve her boredom.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Invisible Enemy. 1962. Joseph Brady, Brian Blessed & Stratford Johns. PCs Smith and Weir investigate a burglary assuming they're looking for a petty crook. What they uncover is much more serious.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is at the Cellar Club to open tonight's special show. Up first is next episode of The Omega Factor: St. Anthony's Fire.

programme.title: The Omega Factor
programme.desc: St Anthony's Fire. 1979. Stars James Hazeldine, Louise Jameson & John Carlisle. Anne accepts an invitation to an experimental unit where she receives a welcome that is too hot for her to handle.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is accompanied by a very special guest to introduce the fantastic 1972 film Burke and Hare.

programme.title: Burke & Hare
programme.desc: 1972. Horror. Director: Vernon Sewell. Stars Derren Nesbitt, Harry Andrews & Glynn Edwards. The 19th century body snatchers, supplying corpses for cash to the pioneering surgeon Dr Knox.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Closing the Cellar Club is Caroline Munro as she dives into what is coming next week.

programme.title: Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense
programme.desc: Last Video and Testament. 1984. Stars Deborah Raffin & David Langton. A wealthy businessman about to undergo surgery has a surprise in store for his wife and her lover.

programme.title: The Silent Partner
programme.desc: 1978. Thriller. Director: Daryl Duke. Stars: Elliott Gould, Susannah York, Christopher Plummer, John Candy. A bank teller skims $50,000 during a robbery, but the crook wants it back.

programme.title: House on Haunted Hill
programme.desc: 1959. Horror. Directed by William Castle. Starring Vincent Price & Carol Ohmart. A millionaire invites five people to a 'haunted house' party, and whoever makes it through the night earns $10,000.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Stour River/Onions. 1986. While it's raining outside his shed, Jack demonstrates his mother's Yorkshire recipe using kidney onions. He then takes a trip along the river Stour.

programme.title: Captain Scarlett
programme.desc: 1953. Adventure. Director: Thomas Carr. Stars Richard Greene, Leonora Amar & Manolo Fabregas. Scarlett returns to France to find the Duke of Corlaine seizing property and terrorising resistors.

programme.title: Watching Points
programme.desc: (Railway Enthusiasts) 1957. A short film detailing the fascinating hobby of building and running model railways and examples of the best models in the United Kingdom!

programme.title: The Black Arrow
programme.desc: The Return of the Black Arrow. 1973. Stars Dorothea Phillips, Eddie Byrne & Sally James. Mistress Hatch learns of a treasure bestowed upon a villager and Lord Brock tries to find the outlaw camp.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: Sir Bliant. 1956. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. Sir Bliant's three sons decide to break the truce King Arthur arranged between their father and Sir Rolf.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Batman's Satisfaction. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. Colonel Gumm planned a heist at a stamp exhibition which results in a showdown between Batman and The Green Hornet.

programme.title: The Roy Rogers Show
programme.desc: Milliner from Medicine Creek. 1953. Stars Roy Rogers, Trigger & Dale Evans. A pretty milliner and her grandfather are suspects in a plan to loot the Wells Fargo office.

programme.title: Stingray
programme.desc: An Echo of Danger. 1964. Stars Robert Easton, Lois Maxwell & Don Mason. Phones' ability to work as Stingray's hydrophone operator is called into question after Agent X20 attempts to sabotage him.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Elixir. 1958. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. A monastery is making a delicious brew, then donating the proceeds to founding a school for Swiss children.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Whale Gold. 1956. Stars Robert Shaw, Noel Purcell & Wilfred Downing. The crew learn that ambergris, used to make perfume, is worth more than gold, causing greed to spread through the group.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: A Husband for Marian. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Maid Marian's absent father has arranged her marriage with the knight who saved her life.

programme.title: Warning From Space
programme.desc: 1956. Sci-Fi. Director: Koji Shima. Stars Keizo Kawasaki, Toyomi Karita & Bin Yagisawa. An alien takes on the form of a female singer to warn the human race about a giant meteor approaching earth.

programme.title: Commandos Strike at Dawn
programme.desc: 1942. War. Directed by John Farrow. Stars Anna Lee, Paul Muni & Ray Collins. A Norwegian fisherman, enraged at the Nazi atrocities against his village, sets out to seek revenge and restore peace.

programme.title: A Woman of Mystery
programme.desc: 1958. Crime Drama. Director: Ernest Morris. Stars Dermot Walsh, Hazel Court & Jennifer Jayne. Ray Savage is assigned to uncover the intricate web of crimes behind Jayne Hayle's sudden death.

programme.title: The 39 Steps (1959)
programme.desc: 1959. Thriller. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Kenneth More, Taina Elg & Brenda de Banzie. A diplomat is inadvertently involved in the death of a spy, fleeing to Scotland to search for clues.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Wedding Guest. 1962. Stars Rupert Davies, John Slater & Philip Latham. A story told in the death cell takes Maigret to a mock wedding where he gains a clue to solving an old murder.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: Coming Home. 1971. Directed by Gerry Mill. Stars Colin Douglas, Barbara Flynn & Coral Atkins. The iconic seventies drama series continues with the third and final series. (S3, E16)

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: 1949. Thriller. Director: Edward Dmytryk. Stars: Robert Newton, Sally Gray & Phil Brown. A cuckolded psychiatrist kidnaps his wife's lover and hides him away while he plans his revenge.

programme.title: The World of Hammer
programme.desc: Lands Before Time. 1994. Narrated by Oliver Reed. A look at the unforgettable genre 'Hammer Glamour', which delivered a singular vision of history with liberal doses of both flesh and fantasy.

programme.title: The World of Hammer
programme.desc: Vamp. 1994. Narrated by Oliver Reed. A look at Hammer's depiction of female vampires, which was consistently groundbreaking and controversial, with the fine line trodden between desire and evil.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1994. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes and Jean Paul Gaultier. Meet 'Gunter', the Italian Alsatian that lives the life of a millionaire and spend a day in the life of French pop band Billy Ze Kick.

programme.title: Blast Off Girls
programme.desc: 1967. Comedy. Director: Herschell Gordon Lewis. Stars Dan Conway, Ray Sager & Tom Tyrell. A sleazy record premotor plans to make a garage band from Chicago famous and keep the profits for himself.

programme.title: Confessions of a Driving Instructor
programme.desc: 1976. Comedy. Director Norman Cohen. Stars Robin Askwith, Anthony Booth & Liz Fraser. The misadventures of Timothy Lea and his brother-in-law when they set up a driving school business.

programme.title: A Lifetime Ago with The Baim Collection
programme.desc: A Printer's Tale. 1960. A 'fact full' film showing the work at Leeds printer John Waddington, featuring pictures printed for jigsaws, boxes for toothpaste and enormous posters.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Queen's Knight. 1956. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. Queen Guinevere is kidnapped by Sir Mordred who demands King Arthur's kingdom in exchange for the queen's life.

programme.title: The Roy Rogers Show
programme.desc: Badman's Brother. 1952. Stars Roy Rogers, Pat Brady & Dale Evans. An 11 year old tries to shield his outlaw brother. Roy and Dale guide him to do the right thing.

programme.title: Stingray
programme.desc: The Ghost Ship. 1964. Stars Robert Easton, Don Mason & David Graham. The Stingray is sent to investigate the wreck of a sailing ship which has risen to the surface and begun sailing again.

programme.title: Dick Tracy's Dilemma
programme.desc: 1947. Crime mystery. Directed by John Rawlins and starring Ralph Byrd, Lyle Latell and Kay Christopher. Tracy investigates the theft of coats and an insurance swindle linked to a hook handed thug.

programme.title: Things to Come
programme.desc: 1936. Sci-fi. Director: William Cameron Menzies. Stars Raymond Massey, Edward Chapman & Ralph Richardson. Futuristic story about the devastation and struggles of society after a decades-long war.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: 1950. Western. Directed by Alan Le May. Stars John Drew Barrymore, Chill Wills & John Archer. Suspicion falls upon a young drifter after a series of murders occur in the Big Bend region of Texas.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Elly Needs a Maw. 1963. Stars Donna Douglas, Doris Packer & Raymond Bailey. Jed plans to go home to look for a wife so Elly May can finally have a mother, but Mr. Drysdale has other plans.

programme.title: The Switch
programme.desc: 1963. Crime. Directed by Peter Maxwell. Stars Anthony Steel, Zena Marshall & Conrad Phillips. A woman is abducted by a wristwatch smuggling gang who believe she knows too much.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Joker's Last Laugh. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. Counterfeit money is being distributed by respectable citizens in Gotham City. One of the Joker's robots is a bank teller.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: 1963. Drama. Stars Cary Grant, Audrey Hepburn & Walter Matthau. Romance and suspense in Paris as a woman is pursued for her murdered husband's stolen fortune.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Serpent Beneath 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Dennis Price & Zena Marshall. A renowned playwright becomes stale so he steals the play of an unknown author which gets him involved in complications.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Shark Affair. 1964. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Leo G. Carroll. Hijackings are happening at sea by a ship flying a pirate flag. Solo and Kuryakin are assigned to investigate.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Mike and Noel go back to 1956, travelling to all four corners of the United Kingdom, Kilkeen, Cardiff, Lincoln & the Isle of Lewis! And watch an incredible short film of a gang of 60s bikers.

programme.title: Steam Beyond the Solent
programme.desc: 1966. An enchanting film about the Solent with a look at the magnificent steam trains operating across the Isle of Wight.

programme.title: The Late Edwina Black
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Director: Maurice Elvey. Stars David Farrar, Geraldine Fitzgerald & Roland Culver. When a Victorian woman dies, a postmortem reveals that her body contains a fatal dose of arsenic.

programme.title: Memories of Making Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: Acclaimed actor William Gaunt shares more memories of co-star on Sergeant Cork, John Barrie.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Stricken Surgeon. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Charles Morgan. When a young surgeon operates on a woman who later dies, Sergeant Cork is called in to solve the case.

programme.title: Who Do You Do?
programme.desc: 1972. With Freddie Starr and Peter Goodwright, guest acts Dailey & Wayne, Roger Kitter and Walter Jackson play a number of roles in a series of sketches and songs!

programme.title: The Haunting of Julia
programme.desc: 1977. Director: Richard Loncraine. Stars Mia Farrow, Kier Dullea & Tom Conti. Mourning Julia Lofting moves to London to restart her life, only to be haunted by the ghosts of other children.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Force on Thunder Mountain
programme.desc: 1978. Sci-Fi. A hiking trip into the mountains brings father and son into contact with the Force.

programme.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
programme.desc: 1947. Musical. Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey play themselves in this rise and rise story of the fabulous Dorsey brothers.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Dead or Alive. 1955. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf, Archie Duncan. Little John, a serf at Rutland Court, is ordered to capture Robin Hood. Discovering the outlaw's camp, John joins the band.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Captain Dan Tempest. 1956. Stars Alec Clunes, Robert Shaw & Peter Hammond. Dan Tempest is arrested for piracy when he returns to New Providence, but he is offered a chance to redeem himself.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Hostages. 1958. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Annoyed by Tell's activities, Gessler issues orders to have the archer arrested but Tell has disappeared.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Judgment Day. Director: Aaron Spelling. After a Judge gives several hardened criminals light sentences, Ringo decides the Jurist needs to see the dangers lawmen face when tracking criminals.

programme.title: Women Without Men
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Directors: Elmo Williams & Bert Glazer. Stars Beverly Michaels & Joan Rice. Angie plans to meet her boyfriend on New Years Eve but winds up in jail. Can she find a way to get to him?

programme.title: It's All Over Town: Scopitone
programme.desc: A compilation of songs from the 1964 musical It's All Over Town, featuring Frankie Vaughan's ''Alley Alley Oh'' and The Batchelors ''The Stars Will Remember''.

programme.title: Now Barabbas Was a Robber
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directed by Gordon Parry. Stars Richard Greene, Cedric Hardwicke & Kathleen Harrison. Prison drama about a variety of criminals and their life behind bars in post-war Britain.

programme.title: To Have And To Hold
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Avis Scott, Patrick Barr & Robert Ayres. Following a riding accident, a countryman spends his final days arranging the future security of his family.

programme.title: No Resting Place
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Director: Paul Rotha. Stars Micheal Gough, Eithne Dunne & Noel Purcell. Garda Officer Mannigan is determined that Alex Kyle will not escape justice for the killing of a gamekeeper.

programme.title: Date With Disaster
programme.desc: 1957. Crime Drama. Directed by Charles Saunders. Stars Tom Drake, William Hartnell & Shirley Eaton. Two owners of a car business plan a heist whilst their other business partner is away.

programme.title: Nowhere To Go
programme.desc: 1958. Crime. Directors: Seth Holt, Basil Dearden. Stars George Nader, Maggie Smith, Bernard Lee. Paul Gregory is released from jail, following a stretch for robbing a woman who falls for his charms.

programme.title: Unknown World
programme.desc: 1951. Sci-fi. Directed by Terry O. Morse. Stars Bruce Kellogg & Otto Waldis. A group of scientists travel to the centre of the Earth to seek a habitable space in the event of a nuclear war.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Blood Line. 1960. Stars Lorne Greene, Jan Sterling & David Macklin. When Todd Grayson arrives in Virginia City and is told that his father has been killed by Ben, he sets out to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Serpent Beneath 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Dennis Price & Zena Marshall. A renowned playwright becomes stale so he steals the play of an unknown author which gets him involved in complications.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Mike & Noel are here for the last episode of 2025. There's some New Year's wishes from the fabulous 50s, they take a nostalgic trip to the New Forest & Vince Hill is twisting the night away.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: Episode 1. 1997. Stars Robson Green, Francesca Annis, David Bradley. Owen Springer arrives in Manchester to look after his father, but his attentions are soon diverted by an enigmatic older woman.

programme.title: Gideon's Way
programme.desc: Fall High, Fall Hard. Stars John Gregson Alexander Davion and Daphne Anderson. There is corruption and murderous cover up in the building industry by the co-owner of the building company.

programme.title: Remember My Name
programme.desc: 1978. Drama. Director: Alan Rudolph. Stars: Geraldine Chaplin, Anthony Perkins & Moses Gunn. Just released from prison, a woman arrives in town to start a new life. Soon starting trouble.
